_about: A frozen plan of credential renames ruled by Sam in session (S679), read by kb/ruled_renames.py in the rename dry run and the apply (cred-rename-apply.yml, only_plan=slash-to-and-2026-11-18). Built by kb/slash_titles.py from kb/credentials.json; append-only. `held` lists the combines the plan leaves for a person; `kept` lists each title whose slash stays, with the rule that keeps it. Nothing here writes kb_curation.
ruling: Sam Lee, in session (S679), 2026-11-18 about 01:10Z: "I believe I replaced the / with and to avoid formatting issues and should be a general rule for other titles. UA Plumbers and Pipefitters"

rule.word: a slash joining words becomes " and "; a chain of three or more takes commas
rule.code: a slash with a code on each side stays: the token holds a digit or is written in capitals
rule.official: a slash inside an official name stays: an ASE or ASE MIL test name's slash pair in a title that names ASE (kb/cert_naming.py), a phrase in OFFICIAL_PHRASES, or a C-ID descriptor title

official_phrases.Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator: California State Fire Training's certification title (Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator 1A, 1B and Tiller)
official_phrases.Division/Group Supervisor: NWCG's position and course title for S-339
official_phrases.Medical/Surgical: the standard nursing term for the adult acute-care specialty (the S679 conductor on COBIx's review of #3479, 2026-11-18)

rule.official_cid_titles: a C-ID descriptor title that prints a slash keeps it, read from kb/reference/cid_descriptors.json (18 titles)
rule.whole_names: a spaced slash between two whole names is held for a person: either side holds "and", or both sides are full titles (two or more words each)
rule.combine: a rename whose "and" title matches a credential or a search alias in kb/credential_aliases.py, case-folded and whitespace squashed, is held as a combine
